programme.desc: As Brooke tries to redeem herself in the consul's eyes, a new realization leads Sandokan and Marianne to a Dayak village hidden in the Sarawak jungle.

programme.title: The Ladies' Paradise
programme.desc: Riccardo wants to prevent the defamatory article about Nicoletta from being published and turns to his sister and Vittorio, while Elena and Salvatore are now sure that Aldo knows about the kiss they shared.

programme.title: Chris Watts: Confessions of a Murderer
programme.desc: When Chris Watts, seemingly calm but with a subtle smile, pleaded with television cameras for the safe return of his pregnant wife, Shanann, and their two missing young daughters, dark secrets lurked just beneath the surface.

programme.title: Quarto 309
programme.desc: Yildirim pays a visit to Nilüfer. Erol decides to expand the business. Erol's grandmother realizes that he lied to her and is furious.

programme.title: The Wrong Man
programme.desc: Zeynep makes a confession to her father. Özgür makes a decision and makes a statement to the La Gabbia team. Gizem demands the position of Ezgi from Özgür. Tolga receives Özgür in her office.

programme.title: Asli among Heirs
programme.desc: Volkan tells Burak about Çagla's suspicions about Asli, and they both realize the fatal consequences this could have for the girl.

programme.title: The Forbidden Fruit
programme.desc: Yildiz is barely saved thanks to her “guardian angel”, but instead of thanking her, she asks for another favor, and Kemal agrees to help her… although everything has a price.

programme.title: The Forbidden Fruit
programme.desc: Zeynep feels trapped between friends and her relationship. If the truth is discovered, many will be angry. The question is whether Zeynep should be a good friend or a good girlfriend… Because she can't be both.

programme.title: eternal love
programme.desc: Kemal is close to finding out what happened that night. Zeynep confesses that she doesn't want to marry Salih. Emir's little secret upsets Nihan.

programme.title: Prometo Amar-te
programme.desc: A car accident leaves Paige in a coma. When she wakes up and reveals that she is suffering from total memory loss, Leo, her husband, has no alternative but to commit himself to winning her over. For the second time...

programme.title: dreamy bird
programme.desc: Sanem thinks he has lost his beautiful necklace and starts desperately looking for it, not knowing that Can is the one who has it. Huma convinces Mevkibe to go shopping together. Aziz asks Emre to return to work at the agency.

programme.title: dreamy bird
programme.desc: Emre confesses to Leyla that he is upset that they never have time to spend together. Sanem steals a small souvenir Can has of her to get revenge, as she knows he stole her necklace.

programme.title: dreamy bird
programme.desc: Can and the rest of the team decide to film the commercial for Sanem creams. Emre asks Leyla to quit her job to start a business together.

programme.title: dreamy bird
programme.desc: A man sues Sanem because he says his creams gave him allergies. Can will do everything he can to demonstrate that he lies. Sanem investigates the qualities that Can looks for in a woman, to win him over.

programme.title: Sandokan: The Pirate Prince
programme.desc: Sandokan comes face to face with the sultan. Meanwhile, Marianne has to deal with her father and make a decision about Brooke. But when she discovers that Sandokan is in danger, she begins to question her feelings for him again.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
programme.desc: Forty-something and single again, Bridget Jones focuses on work. But after meeting Jack, a dashing American, Bridget is surprised by a... pregnancy! The problem is that she is only 50% sure about the identity of the baby's father...

programme.title: A Business Woman
programme.desc: A single mother creates a luxury escort service that matches beautiful young women with the richest and most powerful men in town.

programme.title: Escape from Alcatraz
programme.desc: Frank Morris, a prisoner specialized in escapes with a very high intelligence quotient, is imprisoned in Alcatraz prison. In his head he keeps preparing an escape plan that will not be risk-free.

programme.title: Hulk
programme.desc: Bruce Banner is a renowned scientist, with a murky family past, who suffers with his team a serious laboratory accident in which everyone is exposed to intense gamma radiation. When he discovers that he is the only one who has survived, he is confused and begins to investigate. But Bruce has developed a terrible ability after the accident that could hinder the investigation; when he gets angry he turns into a giant green monster with irrational and destructive behavior. To create the Hulk character using digital technology, the company Light & Magic made the largest technical deployment in its history. It was necessary to work together with one hundred and eighty ILM technicians and work on the character for more than a year and a half. Even so, there are viewers who have compared the technical quality of the Hulk to that of Shrek. In this film, Hulk reaches the largest size he had reached to date, nine meters tall. Ang Lee used the split-screen technique to cinematically imitate the panels of a comic book page. To do this, he had to shoot the same scene several times, which somewhat exhausted actor Eric Bana, who plays Brece Banner. Much of the microbiology work seen on screen is real, done by Ang Lee's wife.

programme.title: Speed: Maximum power
programme.desc: Jack Traven is a young and intrepid Los Angeles SWAT police officer, who to date has succeeded in each of his missions. But this time the danger seems greater and less manageable. He has been locked in a bus with several passengers and a terrorist threatens to blow it up if he is not given three million dollars. If the bus exceeds eighty kilometers per hour or brakes, it will also explode. Just like if any of the passengers decide to get out of the vehicle. Jack is then forced to devise all kinds of strategies to save his life and that of all the civilians who accompany him in this race against time. Actress Sandra Bullock had to learn to drive a bus to play her role in the film. He passed the exam on the first try. According to Graham Yost, Joss Whedon wrote most of the dialogue, he is just not credited as a co-writer. Joss Whedon is the creator of the series 'Buffy the Vampire Slayer' and the director of films such as 'The Avengers' and 'The Cabin in the Woods'. Keanu Reeves initially turned down the role of Jack Traven, thinking the film would be too much like Die Hard. He only accepted the role after Joss Whedon redesigned the script. The actor did ninety percent of the stunts that corresponded to his character.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Alan Parrish is a boy who accidentally finds a board game called Jumanji and convinces his friend Sarah to try it, but very strange events begin to occur and the game will catch them and change their lives. By throwing the dice, Alan is transported to a parallel world, where he will not be able to leave until the game ends, but circumstances cause Sarah to leave and Alan is trapped for 26 years in that other world until two new children find the game and start playing.

programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the jungle
programme.desc: In 1996, a teenager disappears after opening a strange board game. Twenty years later, the sporty Fridge, the pretty Bethany, the geeky Spencer and the clever Martha are punished to clean a classroom at their high school, where they discover an old video game.

programme.title: Jumanji: next level
programme.desc: The lives of Spencer, Martha, Bethany and Fridge have gone their separate ways. The two girls and the sporty Fridge are eager to meet again for Christmas, but Spencer is not so sure.

programme.title: The jewel of the Nile
programme.desc: Jack and Joan are about to get married on a boat on the high seas. But suddenly a horde of pirates attack them and set fire to the facilities. Joan and Jack fight off the tenacious pirates when they realize there is only one place left on the lifeboat. Joan asks Jack to take care of it since she is going to die soon of tuberculosis and it is not worth the man dying. When he leaves she wonders what the buccaneers will do and what her future will be... But this incredible adventure was only part of Joan Wilder's fantasy with which she intends to start writing her new book, in which she is stuck. She has been married to Jack Colton for some time and after the incredible adventures they have had, they find themselves stuck in a port in the south of France bound for Greece, although she would prefer to go to New York. That same afternoon, at a book signing, Joan meets Omar, a benevolent ruler of an Eastern country called Kadir. He invites her to his palace so she can feel like a queen while he writes, but Jack is not amused by this proposition. Quarreled, they decide to separate and take some time while she finishes her book. Suddenly, Joan witnesses how a man named Tarak tries to murder Omar in front of her. For his part, Jack meets a man named Ralph at the port who seeks revenge for his time spent in prison. They both see how a man approaches: it is Tarak, the murderer, who comes to ask them for help. He confesses to them that Omar is actually a horrible dictator who has stolen their most precious treasure, "The Jewel of the Nile." Jack decides to help him when he sees his ship explode and understands that the sheikh intended to kill him and thus, in the process, rescues his wife. But the sheik has great power and it will be very difficult for Jack and Ralph to get their way. The actors who play the tribesmen: Arak, Barak, Karak, Sarak and Tarak, the same ones from the troop of jugglers in The Brothers Karamazov.

programme.title: Shark week
programme.desc: Shark experts return to Plettenberg, South Africa, with new technology: a seal-shaped decoy to study and capture the dramatic battles between sharks and seals.

programme.title: The seventh son
programme.desc: Centuries ago, Master Gregory captured the evil and powerful witch Malkin. But the witch managed to escape and prepares her revenge. Meanwhile, Master Gregory sets out to teach his young apprentice Tom Ward to fight black magic in record time.

programme.title: The source of life
programme.desc: An odyssey about a man's fight to save the woman he loves in three time spaces: the 21st century, the conquest of America, and the future.

programme.title: Haute couture
programme.desc: Esther, first seamstress at the House of Dior, works on her latest Haute Couture collection, before retiring. Jade, a 20-year-old girl, steals her purse on the subway. Days later, repentant, she decides to go and return it. Esther decides to offer him a chance.

programme.title: McFarland
programme.desc: Based on a true story, the film tells the story of Jim White, a small-town California track coach who turns a small team of athletes into champions.

programme.title: Criminal
programme.desc: Dr. Franks is a prestigious neurosurgeon who is going to carry out a unique and very dangerous operation: implant the memories, secrets and abilities of CIA agent Bill Pope who has just died in the mind of another person. This is a cutting-edge method that is presented as the only way the agency has to recover confidential information of vital importance from Pope's memory that compromises the national security of the United States. The problem is that the only candidate to become the vessel of the deceased's mind is Jericho Stewart, a dangerous and unpredictable convict who is on death row awaiting execution and who has a brain abnormality that makes him perfect for the mission. However, no one can assure that the result is the most effective way to stop a terrible conspiracy that is hanging over the country.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Due to radioactive mutations that man has been producing over the years for decades, the sea monster Godzilla appears from the depths of the sea to try to stop a series of monsters, animated by man's scientific arrogance, that threaten to destroy humanity.

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Baby is a young man passionate about music and a talented getaway driver, taking criminals from one point to another to the rhythm of his personal soundtrack. It plots your escape route based on the songs coming out of your iPod and converts them into perfectly synchronized movements. Baby works for Doc, a big-shot crime boss who's on a roll robbing banks in broad daylight thanks to Baby's driving skills. In the same criminal gang there are other professionals such as Buddy, a former stockbroker, Darling, Buddy's wild and scandalous young accomplice, and Bats, an impulsive gunman whose suspicions about Baby begin to cause problems in the operation. When Baby meets the girl of his dreams, a sweet waitress named Débora, he sees an opportunity to abandon his life of crime and make a clean getaway, but decides to complete one last mission before retiring. However, Doc is not going to make it easy for him, so the young driver will have to fight for his love and his freedom.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Texas. Two years before the American Civil War breaks out. King Schultz is a German bounty hunter who is tracking murderers to collect for their heads, and he promises the black slave Django to set him free on the condition that he helps him catch them. Django accepts, since his greatest wish is to go rescue his wife Broomhilda, a slave who is on the plantation of landowner Calvin Candie. This film, written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, is a western film with references to the spaghetti western genre; genre through which I wanted to portray a story about slavery like this one. Tarantino is a renowned American director, producer and screenwriter whose films are characterized by addressing non-linear stories, violence, Grindhouse influences, kung fu and spaghetti westerns. Starring Jamie Foxx ('Bait', 'Collateral'), Christoph Waltz ('Inglourious Basterds', 'Dorian'), Leonardo DiCaprio ('Titanic', 'The Great Gatsby') and Samuel L. Jackson ('S.W.A.T.', 'Star Wars'); The film is a mix of good dialogue, rhythm, irony, and an impeccable soundtrack that allows it to capture the viewer's attention at all times.

However, it won't be the only thing Peter has to face, as the return of an old friend, Harry Osborn, brings new clues about his past.

programme.desc: A gang of thieves plans to rob a building, taking advantage of the arrival of a storm, but the strategy fails when the police want to evacuate the residents from their homes due to the arrival of a category 5 hurricane.

programme.title: Operation: Hurricane
programme.desc: A gang of thieves attempts to carry out an ambitious robbery of the United States Treasury to obtain a loot of 600 million dollars. Meanwhile, a Category 5 hurricane is approaching.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.: Harrelson's Men
programme.desc: Jim Street, former member of the S.W.A.T, was expelled from the team along with his partner Brian Gamble, due to a controversial decision he made in a robbery with hostages case. For Street, his work is his life and he is looking for the opportunity to wear the uniform again. That opportunity comes when Dan "Hondo" Harrelson, the team's commander, must recruit and train five high-level police officers for a new special weapons and tactics team. After a few hard weeks of training, the team goes into action: a drug lord offers a large sum of money to whoever frees him from police control. The S.W.A.T. team He must guard the enemy while being chased by a band of mercenaries. Film version of the famous 70's television series "Harrelson's Men".

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Natalie Cook, Dylan Sanders and Alex Munday are three special agents with overwhelming fighting and combat capabilities. But although each one is very different from the others, they will all be hired by a man named Charlie to carry out a special and very dangerous mission: find Eric Knox, a computer genius kidnapped because of his latest invention: an incredibly precise voice scanner. Through their investigations, Natalie, Dylan and Alex will discover clues that will lead them across the entire world, exuding charm and femininity to achieve their goals and destroying anyone who gets in their way. Drew Barrymore was a huge fan of the "Harry Potter" phenomenon, going so far as to read small parts of the different books to the members of the recording crew and the other actors. At the beginning of the film, when she is seen with glasses and black hair before being hired, she is also reading a Harry Potter book.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels: The Edge
programme.desc: Second part of Charlie's Angels. Dylan, Natalie and Alex are sent by their boss on a new mission: locate a group of rings that have been stolen from the Department of Justice. This device allows its owner to know the list of people who are in the FBI's Witness Protection Program. When the first witnesses begin to appear dead, the Angels will have to use all their ingenuity to solve the case. An exceptional cameo can be seen in this film: one of the original Angels, Jaclyn Smith.

programme.title: Conan the destroyer
programme.desc: Queen Taramis entrusts Conan with a very dangerous mission: to accompany Princess Jehnna on a long journey for which she was born predestined. Their objective is to recover a jewel that is in the possession of a powerful sorcerer. If he succeeds, the queen promises that she will help him recover Valeria, his great love. But the monarch's intentions are very different since with the jewel she wants to bring an ancient god back to life.

programme.title: Escape from Alcatraz

programme.title: The agent
programme.desc: In the year 2030, the world is in a permanent state of economic recession and faces serious environmental problems as a result of global warming. All those citizens who are unproductive are exiled to a colony.

programme.title: Duplicity
programme.desc: MI6 agent Ray Koval (Clive Owen) is in Dubai when he meets Claire Stenwick (Julia Roberts). After groping her a little, he manages to win her over and they spend the night together, without knowing that Claire is part of the CIA. When Ray wakes up the next day, the woman has disappeared with several compromised documents. For years, Ray searches for her, leaves his job at MI6 and gets a new one in the espionage department of a large multinational. In his third week of work he meets Claire again. Now they both work as spies for large companies and Claire is not willing to allow anyone to come and destroy the professional future she has been building for just over a year. The two spies will use all kinds of tricks to keep their positions, but they will also have to fight against the great attraction they feel for each other so as not to succumb to the other person's deceptions. In this film, actor Clive Owen plays MI6 spy Ray Koval. Owen began his career in television, working mainly on not very well-known series. Currently, although he still makes some stellar appearances on television, he is one of the best-known faces on the big screen. He has worked in films such as 'The Bourne Affair', 'King Arthur' and 'Closer' where he shares the bill for the first time with actress Julia Roberts. In 'Duplicity', Roberts plays Claire Stenwick, a retired CIA agent. The acclaimed actress began her career in 1987, in the series 'The History of Crime'. After that she worked in several films until she gained fame through 'Pretty Woman' and her starring role alongside actor Richard Gere. From there her career took off and her charming smile made her 'America's Sweetheart'. He played several leading roles in romantic comedies but he has always tried to combine it with more serious roles such as those he played in 'Stay by me' or 'Erin Brockovich'.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Godzilla is the remake of a 1954 Japanese film called Goiira. In this remake, the film focuses heavily on the people affected by the case, not just the beast. Dr. Nick Tatopoulos is sent to Panama with a group of soldiers to investigate the causes of the destruction of a Japanese ship in the Pacific. There he finds remains of the skin of an animal unknown in the world of science and they believe that they are a mutation resulting from nuclear tests& The giant lizard, whose appearance in this American remake is far from the original Japanese appearance, crosses the ocean and heads to New York, there, in addition to frightening society and causing serious damage, it is attacked by the military forces with missiles from helicopters among other methods, but the beast seems implacable. The effects necessary to give the animal realism cost around 50 million dollars. The film had a total cost of 120 million dollars. Nick, thanks to a blood sample that he managed to take from the animal, discovers that it is a hermaphrodite that collects food for himself and his offspring& This complicates things& The event is followed worldwide and Audrey Timmonds, ex-wife of scientist Nick, steals a video tape from Panama to benefit her journalistic career, which at the same time will bring serious problems for Nick. This film is just one of the many works that came from the original Japanese idea, whose mark is present in video games, comics or animated series.

programme.title: Awakenings
programme.desc: In the mid-1960s, Dr. Malcolm Sayer, a New York neurologist, decided to subject his encephalitis patients to a complex experiment. It is a disease that deprives people who suffer from it of their motor skills until they are reduced to a vegetative state. The new therapy will slowly begin to have results, especially in one patient, Leonard Lowe.

programme.title: The Pelican Report
programme.desc: Two judges of the Superior Court of Justice have been murdered. Now, a university professor who knows both victims will find himself involved in the case in a terrible way. One of his students, with whom he is having a relationship, makes a short report of who might want the men dead and gives it to her teacher. He, amazed by the intuition of Darby Shawn, the student, will give the brief report to one of his friends who works for the FBI. What was not expected is that when they began to analyze it, they were completely fascinated to discover its content. But one of the president's men fears that this report will end up tarnishing his image, so he forces the director to get rid of the papers. Meanwhile, drunk, the professor and Darby argue and when she refuses to give him the keys to her car, it suddenly explodes into a thousand pieces. Terrified, she runs home but sees that they have turned everything upside down and some attackers have taken her computer and hard drives. Darby finds himself in the middle of a huge problem that he couldn't even foresee and although he asks a friend from the FBI for help, he turns up dead just before they meet. The report she has written seems to have enraged a very powerful group of men who will now not hesitate for a second to kill everyone who read it and especially the one who wrote it. The rights to "The Pelican Brief" were sold before the book was even written. John Grisham had only a small outline of what the plot would be like when the production company bought the rights. In fact, writer John Grisham wrote the Darby Shaw parts with Julia Roberts in mind. Julia read the book when it was published and accepted the role without even glancing at the script.

programme.title: Demolition
programme.desc: A successful executive struggles to understand his emotional disconnection after the sudden and tragic death of his wife in a car accident. Despite his father-in-law's pressure to recover, Davis remains bewildered and reflects this by compulsively disassembling increasingly conspicuous objects around him.

programme.title: the whole truth
programme.desc: Tom is accused of having murdered innocent civilians in El Salvador, fifteen years ago, in a secret military operation. His wife, Claire, is ready to discover the whole truth...

programme.title: John Q
programme.desc: John Q. Archibald is an ordinary man, who works for hours in a factory to support his family. John lives focused on his wife Denise and his son Michael, to whom he dedicates practically all of his time. Everything goes wrong when their son falls ill and the hospital tells them that he needs a heart transplant as soon as possible, otherwise he will die. The child does not have medical insurance that covers the intervention, so he is outside the allocation plan and the prognosis is very negative. Seeing how his son awaits the fatal outcome and without money with which to face the operation, John decides to make a decision that may save his life, even if it involves breaking some limits.

programme.title: The jury
programme.desc: A young New Orleans widow files a civil lawsuit against a powerful corporate consortium whom she blames for her husband's death. Thus, a multimillion-dollar case is launched. Judicial thriller based on a novel by John Grisham, a best-selling writer who is well versed in all the ins and outs of United States law.

programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: The death of Cambridge academic Jason Arday has prompted intense debate about media conduct, following weeks of reporting on allegations of plagiarism and questions about aspects of his life story. Critics have accused journalists of contributing to an atmosphere of relentless scrutiny, while others argue that legitimate public interest questions were being pursued. Nick Clark, a childhood friend of Jason Arday, reflects on his experience of speaking to reporters. Charles Moore, columnist at The Telegraph and The Spectator, freelance journalist Seun Matiluko, Times columnist Sarah Ditum and columnist at the Financial Times Stephen Bush consider questions of proportionality, public interest and journalistic responsibility.

programme.title: Talking Business
programme.desc: Is the space economy the next gold rush? Elon Musk's SpaceX has sparked the public's imagination after its recent stock market debut, but what will all the money being thrown into the space industry actually achieve? The founder of leading investment firm Space Capital, Chad Anderson, explains how what happens in orbit is increasingly important to the economy down on Earth. Ben Thompson also hears from the head of the UN's Office for Outer Space Affairs, Aarti Holla-Maini, about how space law is keeping up with an industry that is moving at breakneck speed. Also on the programme, the billionaire founder of New Zealand-based Rocket Lab, Sir Peter Beck, shines a light on what the private sector can achieve in space and whether SpaceX are friends or rivals.

programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: The death of Cambridge academic Jason Arday has prompted intense debate about media conduct, following weeks of reporting on allegations of plagiarism and questions about aspects of his life story. Critics have accused journalists of contributing to an atmosphere of relentless scrutiny, while others argue that legitimate public interest questions were being pursued. Nick Clark, a childhood friend of Jason Arday, reflects on his experience of speaking to reporters. Charles Moore, columnist at The Telegraph and The Spectator, Seun Matiluko, freelance journalist, Sarah Ditum, Times Columnist and Stephen Bush, columnist at the Financial Times, consider questions of proportionality, public interest and journalistic responsibility.

programme.title: World's Ultimate Adventures
programme.desc: Lizzie Daly heads to Mersin on the Turkish Mediterranean coast, where ancient history, wildlife and mythology collide. Shaped by her passion for conservation, Lizzie follows the Cilicia Trail through dramatic landscapes, joins Turkish scientists protecting the endangered brown fish owl, and takes to the sea in search of dolphins in one of the Mediterranean's least understood ecosystems. Through her unique perspective as a wildlife biologist and adventurer, she reveals a fascinating and unexpected side of the country.

programme.title: Jubah Tak Kasat Mata
programme.desc: Sinta, gadis cantik dan ambisius dari keluarga kurang mampu. Setelah menemukan Jubah Tak Kasat Mata di toko Kr. Amat, dia menyusup masuk ke rumah Poppy dan mencuri uang dari brankas. Tapi ternyata jubah tersebut membawa kutukan.

programme.title: Harta Karun Nenek Bajak
programme.desc: Putri mempunyai kekasih yang terlibat hutang bernama Draco. Saat sedang terdesak dia teringat bahwa dia memiliki kenalan bernama Mira yang memiliki nenek kaya raya bernama Nenek Bajak di kampungnya. Putri menipu Nenek Bajak.

programme.title: Toko Kr.Amat : Teko 1001 Malam
programme.desc: Rani, cewek cupu yang dirundung teman-temannya dan kerap mendapat perlakuan buruk. Ia juga mendapat perlakuan kasar dari tantenya. Rani menemukan teko usang, ketika digosok keluar sosok jin yang bisa mengabulkan tiga permintaan.

programme.title: Yuk Kita Sholat
programme.desc: Sally adalah idola kampus yang diperebutkan oleh Sam dan Sony. Sementara Sally hanya menyukai Bambang. Akhirnya Sam dan Sony meminta bantuan dukun untuk mengirim santet. hingga Bambang meninggal dunia.

programme.title: Pesona Semar Mesem
programme.desc: Nirmala dulunya adalah gadis buruk rupa yang sering ditolak pria, tapi sejak menggunakan mustika semar mesem dia berubah cantik. Dia memanfaatkannya untuk membalas dendam kepada para pria yang pernah menolaknya.

programme.title: Uji Nyali Belum Selesai
programme.desc: Juned mengendarai motor dan mengalami kecelakaan. Sialnya dia sedang membawa sebuah televisi karena dia seorang kurir. Untuk menggantinya,Juned ikut acara uji nyali agar mendapatkan hadiah uang. Namun hal-hal menyeramkan terjadi.

programme.title: Kabayan Mencari Cinta
programme.desc: Sosok legendaris tanah Sunda, Kabayan, kembali hadir. Kali ini, dia bertekad untuk melengkapi kehidupan asmaranya: ia mencari cinta!

programme.title: Manusia Ikan Jatuh Cinta
programme.desc: Karena ayahnya bangkrut, Risa terpaksa pindah ke sebuah kampung dekat laut. Di sana, saat dia nyaris tenggelam, tiba-tiba ada yang membawanya ke permukaan. Saat tersadar, dia hanya melihat sekilas manusia dengan sirip ikan.

programme.title: The Power Of Emak-Emak
programme.desc: Ibu Elis mengkhawatirkan Ira, anaknya yang pacaran dengan Andra. Ira tidak menyadari Andra itu playboy. Ibu Elis tidak setuju Ira melanjutkan hubungannya dengan Andra karena Andra sudah dua kali menabrak Ibu Elis.

programme.title: OMG Aku Cinta Kamu
programme.desc: Bella pusing karena usahanya mengalami penurunan. Ini disebabkan oleh tukang cireng yang berjualan di samping toko miliknya. Ketika Bella ingin memarahi si penjual tersebut, dia justru terpukau oleh ketampanannya penjual tersebut

programme.title: Gara Gara Kitab
programme.desc: Jack, seorang pencuri yang sedang buron. Suatu ketika ia merampok sebuah rumah dan mengambil satu peti mewah. Ia mengira itu adalah peti yang memuat perhiasan serta uang banyak, namun ternyata isinya benar-benar di luar dugaan.

programme.title: 7 Pusaka - Sabuk Penghilang Raga
programme.desc: Raga adalah seorang maling kelas teri yang bernasib sial. Saat dikejar para warga dan bersembunyi di dalam sebuah kali, tiba-tiba Raga menemukan sebuah koin gobang yang hanyut. Saat Raga menggenggam koin itu, ia menghilang.

programme.title: Pembalap Insyaf
programme.desc: Vivi harus menghidupi keluarganya dengan bekerja sebagai pembalap liar untuk Angga. Sementara Bayu adalah seorang polisi. Ketika balapan liar digerebek secara tiba-tiba. Vivi melarikan diri dan pingsan di sebuah musala.

programme.title: Stalker With Love
programme.desc: Sania kabur ke desa untuk mencari Adi kekasihnya yang tiba-tiba menghilang. Kaburnya Sania tentu saja membuat terkejut kedua orang tua Sania, segala daya upaya pun dilakukan untuk mencarinya.

programme.title: Toko Kr.Amat Sepeda Onthel Badai
programme.desc: Guntur berencana membeli sepeda ontel di toko Kr.Amat yang katanya bisa melaju secepat cahaya hanya dengan sekali kayuh. Terbukti ketika Guntur mengayuh pedal tiba-tiba sepeda itu melesat sangat kencang lalu lenyap dalam sekejap.

programme.title: Cinta Lutung Kasarung
programme.desc: Rara yang culas dan ambisius kecewa ketika Sari terpilih sebagai pewaris utama Prabu. Rara bersekongkol dengan Indra tunangannya untuk menyingkirkan Sari dengan memberinya ramuan yang membuat kulitnya bersisik

programme.title: Cinta Lutung Kasarung
programme.desc: Rara yang culas dan ambisius kecewa ketika Sari terpilih sebagai pewaris utama Prabu. Rara bersekongkol dengan Indra tunangannya untuk menyingkirkan Sari dengan memberinya ramuan yang membuat kulitnya bersisik

programme.title: Saat Teduh Bersama Gereja Mawar Sharon
The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang dan putri Jin yang bernama Peony sudah bertunangan sejak lahir, tetapi Jin menolak pertunangan tersebut. Kemudian, Zhang bertemu dengan sesosok roh yang terlihat persis seperti Peony dan mereka jatuh cinta.

programme.title: The Pure And The Evil
programme.desc: Reuni dua teman SMA yang semula manis segera berubah menjadi mimpi buruk erotis yang mengerikan ketika Rose tertarik pada mantan teman sekelasnya, Fang, dan tunangan barunya!

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Sebuah film komedi romantis yang dibintangi oleh Liang Tien dan Chang Yin, yang berkisah tentang perseteruan lama antara seorang penipu pemula dan seorang penipu yang telah berpengalaman.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: Di tahun 1973, bursa saham meroket, namun masalah-masalah sosial di Hong Kong terus memburuk. Bintang-bintang besar TVB dan Shaw Brothers bersatu dalam kisah yang lucu ini.

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: Enchanted Shadow terdiri dari tiga kisah. Suami dan istri yang harus berhati-hati dengan apa yang mereka inginkan, hantu perempuan tanpa busana yang ingin balas dendam dan wanita tuna susila yang menjadi hantu.

programme.title: The Story Of Sue San
programme.desc: Wang adalah putra pejabat pemerintah yang dihormati, sedangkan Sue San adalah seorang wanita penghibur nan terkenal. Meskipun dan terlihat cocok dan saling mencintai, keduanya sangat berbeda dalam tingkatan sosial.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Seorang ahli bela diri licik mengincar para pendekar pedang muda berbakat. Ia menantang mereka dengan taruhan bahwa pihak yang kalah harus memotong lengannya sendiri, lalu mengalahkan mereka menggunakan jurus rahasia yang tak mampu mereka tangkis. Namun, salah satu korban terdahulunya memutuskan bahwa sudah saatnya menghentikan semua itu.

programme.title: Apartment For Ladies
programme.desc: Betty Ting Pei berperan sebagai seorang penyanyi Taiwan yang datang ke Hong Kong untuk mencari adiknya yang hilang. Ia hampir diperkosa oleh geng jalanan dan diselamatkan oleh seorang komposer tampan.

programme.title: Apartment For Ladies
programme.desc: Betty Ting Pei berperan sebagai seorang penyanyi Taiwan yang datang ke Hong Kong untuk mencari adiknya yang hilang. Ia hampir diperkosa oleh geng jalanan dan diselamatkan oleh seorang komposer tampan.

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: Si cantik Jenny Hu berperan sebagai Judy, sang penggoda yang merayu tiga pria berbeda: seorang pria kaya, seorang playboy seksi, dan seorang pria terpelajar nan sensitif dalam pencariannya akan uang, seks dan cinta.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Kisah ini bercerita tentang Lin Shao-teh, seorang mahasiswa miskin yang bertunangan dengan Chien-king, putri dari seorang miliarder bernama Wang Chun.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: Tiga gadis pergi ke Jepang untuk mengambil warisan yang tak terduga dan bertemu tiga pria dengan niat yang sama. Pertarungan sengit pun terjadi untuk memperebutkan warisan tersebut.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: Tiga pendekar kung fu dari latar belakang yang sangat berbeda menjadi murid Shaolin di kuil yang sama: Lo Lieh sang Pengawal Kerajaan, Lo Meng sang tentara yang melarikan diri, dan Wang Yu si pria desa.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: Sebagai hukuman atas perilaku buruknya, putri Kaisar Jade yang ke-tujuh diusir dari surga dan dikirim untuk tinggal bersama manusia. Di sana, ia jatuh cinta dengan seorang pemuda desa bernama Dong Young.

programme.title: The Trail Of The Broken Blade

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Cold-adapted animals are struggling in a warming world - high in the peaks of the Indian Himalayas, a snow leopard is forced from his home by a rival male and embarks on a journey lower into the valley where he encounters the human world. Elsewhere, an arctic ground squirrel in Alaska undertakes the coldest migration of any mammal - to do so, he shuts down many of his biological processes. When he awakes, the squirrel must go through puberty again before finding a mate who is only receptive for a single day - the problem is that the warm weather has brought her out a week early and, despite the intention, he is not equipped to mate. Unless they can adapt quickly, their whole species is under threat - meanwhile, a young arctic fox in Svalbard must face her first winter alone and cross more than 2000 miles of semi-frozen ocean to find polar bears on the sea ice there.

programme.title: WhatsApp Obsession: The Murder of Stephanie Hansen
programme.desc: On the 30th of December, 2022, 39-year-old Stephanie Hansen was brutally stabbed to death in her London home - her housemate and friend Sheldon Rodrigues initially appeared grief-stricken, yet behind his facade lay a chilling obsession. In the months before Stephanie's death, Rodrigues planted secret cameras and recording devices in their home and bombarded her with coercive WhatsApp messages - when Steph began a new relationship, his jealousy turned deadly. Through exclusive access to police bodycam footage, WhatsApp records and court evidence, this film reveals how the Metropolitan Police exposed Rodrigues' lies and uncovered the disturbing level of surveillance Steph was subjected to - featuring interviews with Steph's family, friends and the detectives who investigated the case, this powerful documentary unravels a story of obsession, control, and the ultimate betrayal.

programme.desc: Tom Kerridge is on the road in Sicily meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. He then cooks up delicious dishes that celebrate these citruses. Near the historic port of Ortigia he learns how the lemons that are beloved on the island were the lifeblood of British global exploration before cooking up a delicious Victoria sponge with lemon curd and candied lemons. His journey then takes him to the Catania Plain to discover how the weather system created by Mount Etna gives the island's blood oranges their distinctive coloration. After a hard day's work Tom cooks a delicious roast chicken and fennel with blood orange vinaigrette to celebrate.

programme.desc: Doo Hyeon yang dikenal dengan nama "Goblin" masuk penjara karena jatuh cinta pada Yeong Min yang membunuh bosnya. Setelah 10 tahun, Doo Hyeon dibebaskan dan telah menjalani kehidupan normal. Namun, dia harus menerima kenyataan bahwa Yeong Min telah memanfaatkan namanya "Goblin". Yeong Min bahkan menculik putrinya untuk tutup mulut. Doo Hyeon marah, melakukan balas dendam dan mengumumkan kembalinya "Goblin" yang asli.

programme.title: Cafe Midnight

programme.title: Hi-Five
programme.desc: Hi-Five mengisahkan lima orang biasa yang hidupnya berubah setelah menerima transplantasi organ dari donor misterius yang sama. Tidak lama kemudian, mereka menyadari bahwa transplantasi tersebut memberikan kemampuan luar biasa yang berbeda-beda pada masing-masing orang. Saat masih berusaha memahami kekuatan baru mereka, muncul seorang pria berbahaya yang ingin menguasai kemampuan tersebut demi ambisinya sendiri. Terpaksa bersatu meskipun memiliki latar belakang dan kepribadian yang berbeda, kelima tokoh ini menjalani petualangan penuh aksi, humor, dan tantangan untuk menghadapi ancaman yang mengincar mereka. Dengan nuansa superhero khas Korea, film ini menghadirkan kisah seru tentang kerja sama, keberanian, dan persahabatan.

programme.title: Tuning – it doesn’t get any lower than that!
programme.desc: The 82nd International Motor Show in Geneva is the first important vehicle trade fair in the new year. 260 exhibitors present 850 exhibition vehicles on an area of ​​110,000 m2. Around 180 world and European premieres will be shown. Of course, the top-class refiners should not be missing. Only the crème de la crème of fine tuning gathers here. Also: The SL 63 AMG. The now sixth generation of the SL is more powerful than ever before. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: Top Speed ​​in Focus is all about classic vehicles – seen through the eyes of ambitious amateur photographers. A total of nine candidates compete against each other in three preliminary rounds. In each preliminary round, three participants competed in two photo tasks for points and a place in the grand finale. Today it will be decided who will convince with the best sense of image composition, technology and storytelling. In the final, Jens, Chiara and Ralf compete against each other. This episode is filmed at the Top Mountain Motorcycle Museum in Hochgurgl. The works will again be assessed by Daniel Reinhard, internationally renowned motorsport photographer. Profes (station info).

programme.title: Australian Drag Racing Championship 2024
programme.desc: The "Australian Drag Racing Championship" is a regional motorsport series for top petrol dragsters that reach speeds of around 500 km/h in under 5 seconds (channel information).

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing professionals are carried out of the curve, then we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of sophisticated tin bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed. (Station info).

programme.title: Dumbest Stuff on Wheels
programme.desc: Bizarre mishaps, weird crashes and unbelievable nonsense on four wheels, fabricated in everyday life and immortalized on camera. Great workout for your laughing muscles! (Station info).

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Lots of chrome, free-standing lamp pots, bulbous fenders, swelling shapes wherever you look – typical pre-war look. The Triumph 1800 was the British manufacturer's first new design after the Second World War. The four-seater with a mother-in-law seat, presented in 1947, established the long tradition of the British post-war roadster. The 1800 is not a tough corner robber, but rather a comfortable tourer for leisurely country trips. Also in the show: BMW 507 and Porsche 356 Cabrio. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: At the Classic Classic in Stuttgart, where founder Karl Ulrich Herrmann says goodbye after 20 successful years, top speed presenter Martin Utberg is looking for the answer to the question of whether classic cars have a future. (Station info).

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: The Stunt Heroes are always looking for action. In this episode they simulate a chase between a dump truck and a car. At the end the car crashes into a pile of gravel. Because it's his birthday today, stuntman Stefan had to drive the crash car! (Station info).

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.sub-title: Catalonia 2024, rush of curves in the Catalan mountains,
programme.desc: Motorcycling in Catalonia means driving fun in untouched wilderness, on lonely mountain roads, countless curves and breathtaking panoramas. On the way, medieval villages such as Peratallada, Besalu or Rupit enchant with their unique charm. This motorcycle travel film shows the highlights of our tours through the Spanish Pyrenees with fantastic drone footage and unique driving footage. (Station info).

programme.title: On Tour
programme.desc: Motorvision on Tour today in deepest Austria, at Lake Zenz. A particularly cool event takes place here: Snow & Ice Drifting and this is where our presenter will of course learn to drift today. And not with just anyone - he's looking for the coolest professional racing team in rallying. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: Karl Kerschbaumer is not only active as a farmer in the Carinthian mountains between Spittal an der Drau and Villach. In his garage there are not agricultural machines and tractors, but capricious beauties from the Alfa Romeo brand. Classic visited the Alfa collector. Also: With the ADAC Bavaria Historic, probably the most renowned classic car rally in southern Germany is entering the next round. (Station info).

programme.title: Green wave
programme.desc: Natural gas is on everyone’s lips. CNG cars used to be labeled as eco-friendly, but they are currently enjoying a new lease of life. The alternative fuel offers significant advantages over diesel or electric. Motorvision is conducting the practical test with the Audi A5 G-Tron sedan, the Fiat Panda CNG small car and the compact Seat Leon ST CNG. (Station info).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.desc: The Range Rover Velar – The vehicle is a milestone for the traditional British company Land Rover. It takes the mid-size SUV segment to a whole new level of luxury. Extendable door handles and laser lights are just two of the many technical highlights. MOTORVISION TV accompanies the creation of the Velar and shows English craftsmanship paired with modern mass production. (Station info).

programme.title: Four-wheel drive adventure
programme.desc: Adventure Allrad, a special interest magazine about off-road and all-wheel drive vehicles. The focus is on off-road veterans and cars with four-wheel drive. (Station info).

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: In today's episode of Perfect Ride we'll show you some really cool cars. The newest crawler from Wolfsburg is in the starting blocks. We test the VW Beetle in the convertible version. Also: This time the Stuck brothers chose a rather unknown specimen for the track test: the Lexus IS-F. (Station info).

programme.title: 4x4 – Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: Pick-ups are universal commercial vehicles that are primarily driven by commercial drivers in this country. In the USA, on the other hand, “trucks” are almost as widespread as SUVs. What makes flatbed trucks so attractive? 4x4 tests the German VW Amarok and compares it with a Japanese veteran: the Toyota Hilux. Off-road expert Kurt Sigl and Toyota expert Alexander Wolfarth test the two opponents off-road and on the road. (Station info).

programme.title: Tuning – it doesn’t get any lower than that!
programme.desc: The BSG Racing crew is very familiar with spectacular conversions. Dirk Hattenhauer and his boys have already refined quite a few cars. Now they have taken on a very special project. You want to really spruce up an old Opel Kadett C Coupé. But not just like that. The car is supposed to be the most spectacular custom car the European tuning scene has to offer. But before that happens, there is still a lot of work ahead of them. Today is the most important step in the renovation: the wedding. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: Together with his teammate Franz Wittner, top speed presenter Martin Utberg is taking part in the Ennstal Classic 2024, one of the most famous and beautiful vintage car rallies in Europe, in a Mercedes Benz 200 S from 1959. (Station info).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: It is the car of reason, it is not exciting, but it is the mega seller: the VW Golf, the most successful car in Europe, sold 30 million times. The Golf is mass compatible, classless and it dominates the compact car class. Because of its success, it has long been called the golf class. The models from the I series have long been cult, especially the legendary Golf Gti and the Golf convertible. Car History tells the story of the Golf generation and explains the secret of its success. (Station info).

programme.title: Super Cars
programme.sub-title: Unbridled power in the finest packaging
programme.desc: The facelift of the E-Class was worth around a billion euros to Mercedes! The E 63 AMG also benefits from this. The high-performance brand from Mercedes-Benz has made further improvements to the appearance, but above all to the technology. The performance of the S model with the 5.5-liter biturbo V8, for example, increases to 585 hp. But the most important change is certainly the 4Matic all-wheel drive, which is available for the first time in this AMG model. (Station info).

programme.title: NTT Indycar Series 2026
programme.sub-title: Chevrolet Detroit GP, Streets of Detroit, Michigan

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Sebastian Vettel is the new hero of motorsport. At just 23 years old, he won his first world championship title in 2010, making him the youngest Formula 1 champion of all time. Motorheads shows an exciting documentary about the rise, the fans, the life and the dreams of the Heppenheimer. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: Italy is the land of automotive dreams and home to the most beautiful classic car event in the world: the Mille Miglia. Every year the entire nation is enchanted by the myth of historic automobiles. Only vehicles built between 1924 and 1957 that were either present at the historic Mille or would at least have been eligible to take part are eligible to take part. (Station info).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: It is the second largest automobile manufacturer in the world, Volkswagen AG. But at the beginning of the 1970s, VW was in crisis. VW has no answer to the oil price shock and no successor to the Beetle. Only with the new generation Passat and Golf cars will the factory get back on the fast track. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: In 1990, the fastest one-make cup in the world started its first season: the Porsche Carrera Cup. The 911 Carrera 2 Cup Coupé with a six-cylinder boxer engine with 265 hp and 35 hot-blooded and ambitious racing drivers - the hottest racing cocktail in the world was ready. (Station info).

programme.title: Top speed – on the go
programme.desc: In On the Road, presenter Martin Utberg takes a guest who has a special affinity for motorsport, classic automobiles or super sports cars on a ride in his car. The conversations are unedited, personal and open - far from pre-written questions. In 24 minutes it's about careers, passions, relationships and everything you can't find about the guest on Wikipedia. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: Together with his team partner Nikolei Nussbaumer, presenter Martin Utberg takes part in the Heidelberg Historic, one of the most beautiful vintage car rallies in Germany, in a Porsche 356 convertible. From the Technik Museum Sinsheim, the participants lead over attractive routes and put their skills to the test in the special stages. The highlights include the trip over the Old Bridge of Heidelberg and through the pedestrian zone of the old town. In short: a top speed classic episode that you shouldn't miss. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The world of classic automobiles is colorful and diverse. Crazy rally cars from the eighties with a lot of noise, cute little cars to kiss and big chrome sleds from America with big V8 engines and lots of torque. In "Best of Classic Ride" we once again present you the most beautiful stories from the past broadcasts. (Channel info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: Moderator Martin Utberg takes the audience to the Klassikwelt Bodensee in Friedrichshafen, an event that is much more than a classic car fair. In addition to vintage and youngtimers, visitors can expect a varied program with demonstration drives of historic racing cars, an air show, a historic paddock and numerous encounters with collectors, racing drivers and enthusiasts. Top Speed ​​discovers why the Klassikwelt Bodensee is one of the most diverse classical events in Europe. (Station info).

programme.title: Icelandic Formula Offroad 2025
programme.desc: Formula Off Road was invented in Iceland. Hoping to raise more money for the Icelandic rescue teams, the teams began showing their 4WD cars in action in the Icelandic hills. (Station info).

A particularly cool event takes place here: Snow & Ice Drifting and this is where our presenter will of course learn to drift today. And not with just anyone - he's looking for the coolest professional racing team in rallying. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: Karl Kerschbaumer is not only active as a farmer in the Carinthian mountains between Spittal an der Drau and Villach. In his garage there are not agricultural machines and tractors, but capricious beauties from the Alfa Romeo brand. Classic visited the Alfa collector. Also: With the ADAC Bavaria Historic, probably the most renowned classic car rally in southern Germany is entering the next round. (Station info).

programme.title: Green wave
programme.desc: Natural gas is on everyone’s lips. CNG cars used to be labeled as eco-friendly, but they are currently enjoying a new lease of life. The alternative fuel offers significant advantages over diesel or electric. Motorvision is conducting the practical test with the Audi A5 G-Tron sedan, the Fiat Panda CNG small car and the compact Seat Leon ST CNG. (Station info).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.desc: The Range Rover Velar – The vehicle is a milestone for the traditional British company Land Rover. It takes the mid-size SUV segment to a whole new level of luxury. Extendable door handles and laser lights are just two of the many technical highlights. MOTORVISION TV accompanies the creation of the Velar and shows English craftsmanship paired with modern mass production. (Station info).

programme.title: Four-wheel drive adventure
programme.desc: Adventure Allrad, a special interest magazine about off-road and all-wheel drive vehicles. The focus is on off-road veterans and cars with four-wheel drive. (Station info).

programme.desc: In today's episode of Perfect Ride we'll show you some really cool cars. The newest crawler from Wolfsburg is in the starting blocks. We test the VW Beetle in the convertible version. Also: This time the Stuck brothers chose a rather unknown specimen for the track test: the Lexus IS-F. (Station info).

programme.title: 4x4 – Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: Pick-ups are universal commercial vehicles that are primarily driven by commercial drivers in this country. In the USA, on the other hand, “trucks” are almost as widespread as SUVs. What makes flatbed trucks so attractive? 4x4 tests the German VW Amarok and compares it with a Japanese veteran: the Toyota Hilux. Off-road expert Kurt Sigl and Toyota expert Alexander Wolfarth test the two opponents off-road and on the road. (Station info).

programme.title: Tuning – it doesn’t get any lower than that!
programme.desc: The BSG Racing crew is very familiar with spectacular conversions. Dirk Hattenhauer and his boys have already refined quite a few cars. Now they have taken on a very special project. You want to really spruce up an old Opel Kadett C Coupé. But not just like that. The car is supposed to be the most spectacular custom car the European tuning scene has to offer. But before that happens, there is still a lot of work ahead of them. Today is the most important step in the renovation: the wedding. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: Together with his teammate Franz Wittner, top speed presenter Martin Utberg is taking part in the Ennstal Classic 2024, one of the most famous and beautiful vintage car rallies in Europe, in a Mercedes Benz 200 S from 1959. (Station info).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: It is the car of reason, it is not exciting, but it is the mega seller: the VW Golf, the most successful car in Europe, sold 30 million times. The Golf is mass compatible, classless and it dominates the compact car class. Because of its success, it has long been called the golf class. The models from the I series have long been cult, especially the legendary Golf Gti and the Golf convertible. Car History tells the story of the Golf generation and explains the secret of its success. (Station info).

Also: Five exciting facts about the brand new third generation of the Audi Q3. (Station info).

programme.desc: How will we transport goods and people in the future? The pack mules on our roads are also evolving and moving with the times. VW is working with Ford to save costs and pool expertise on the new van. At Volvo, safety has always been a priority – and that also applies to its trucks. And 5 exciting facts about the Mercedes eCitaro NMC4. (Station info).

programme.title: On Tour
programme.desc: To crash or to be crashed, that is the big question at the stock car race in Herzfelde! It doesn't take much to catapult your competitors out of the race. Take a vehicle that is ready for scrap, remove the glass, small parts, back seat and passenger seat. Airbags are undesirable. A crash helmet, seat belt and roll bar are completely sufficient here. (Station info).

programme.sub-title: Classic car dreams lived – Florida II
programme.desc: What is the American car of the 60s? The symbol of American car construction of this time? No question, most US car fans would answer: Chevrolet Corvette or the Ford Mustang. While searching for these American dream cars, Tillmann Miritz makes a surprising discovery while traveling through Florida. At REVOLOGY CARS in Orlando, original 1964 Ford Mustang bodies are handcrafted with the latest technology and engines and Tillmann can take one of these wonderful replicas for a test drive. (Station info).

programme.desc: The New Zealand Jetsprint Championship is the most important sprint boat competition from New Zealand, the country where the sport was founded in 1981. Jetsprinting is comparable to rally sports, but there is only one boat on the track at any given time and boats drive at very high speeds. The up to 500 HP strong jet sprint boats therefore try to achieve the best time on the tracks. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: The name Rolls Royce has always stood for exclusivity, luxury and British automotive engineering. The legendary vehicles with the Spirit of Ecstasy on the radiator grille have been built in England since the beginning of the 20th century. Today it is mainly very wealthy people who make the decision to purchase a Rolls Royce. No two ordered models are the same. Because the Bespoke customization department leaves no wish for individualization unfulfilled and so each vehicle is an absolutely unique piece. Made in takes a look behind the scenes at the Rolls Royce factory in southern England. (Station info).

Now the current Camaro is finally available in Europe. In addition: This is undoubtedly the most powerful opponent of the BMW X5M or X6M. The Mercedes ML 63 AMG. (Station info).

programme.sub-title: Classics on the way to auction
programme.desc: In this episode of Top Speed, presenter Martin Utberg visits the vintage car gallery in Toffen, Switzerland. It has been a regular address for lovers of classic automobiles for over four decades and is known for its regular vintage car auctions. Together with auctioneer Serge Stotzer and his team, Martin takes a look behind the scenes of the preparations for the next auction. Some of the vehicles that will go under the hammer on Saturday, March 21st will be presented in more detail - and Martin will also get behind the wheel himself to experience these classics on the road. An exciting preview (channel information).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Exciting and breathtaking, it is the archetype of all sports cars, the Jaguar E-Type. The mini skirt and its long hood characterize the style of the sexy sixties. The E-Type is a sports car of the century whose shapes still quicken the pulse today. The most beautiful car ever built is too beautiful to have a successor. Those responsible at Jaguar waited almost 40 years before they dared to continue the legend. (Station info).

programme.title: Super Cars
programme.desc: For fans of sports cars, the name Pagani sounds like thunder. The small car manufacturer is located in San Cesario sul Panaro and their new Huayra model is more brutal than almost any other sports car - and is one of the most exclusive things you can buy. Former Formula 1 driver Adrian Sutil will test this “uber car” for us. (Station info).

programme.desc: It is always overshadowed by the all-powerful BMW 507. The BMW 503 Convertible, also designed by Graf Goertz, offers a decisive advantage: the open exit can even be enjoyed with the whole family in the stately V8-engined convertible. Classic Ride takes this beautiful classic for a spin. Also: 40 years ago, Porsche presented the sports car elemental Porsche 911 Turbo. The birth of a legend. The company car of probably the most famous TV investigator. Inspector Columbo's Peugeot 403 convertible. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: The Altmühltal Classic Sprint is a uniformity race for historic automobiles. The three-day classic car rally starts once a year in Nuremberg, runs across Middle Franconia and on the second day through the picturesque Altmühltal. The event motto is From Friends for Friends. Top Speed ​​presenter Martin Utberg is there together with team partner Michael Hurnaus, behind the wheel of a unique Mercedes Benz AMG. (Station info).

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: This episode of Stunt Heroes is all about stunt driver Christoph Knobloch called Knobi. He drives over a ramp at 50 km/h and crashes into cars stacked on top of each other. The dangerous thing about the stunt: several gasoline barrels explode at the same time! If something goes wrong, Knobi is also in danger.... (channel info).

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: South Africa stands for adventure, lively metropolises and wild animals. This documentary shows our 3700 km long tour from Cape Town to the Northern Cape region and back again. The film shows the highlights around Cape Town, the Aguila Game Resort, the wild Augrabie Falls, the largest diamond mine in the world near Kimberley and great safaris with the Big Five. It goes through the foothills of the Little Karoo and Kalahari Deserts and across the Western Cape region, the famous Chapmans Peak Drive back to Cape Town. (Station info).

programme.desc: In Cernobbio, directly on Lake Como, the Concorso DEleganza Villa dEste, a special kind of beauty contest for vehicles, takes place every year. BMW has been the patron of this event since 1995. In 2001, the focus was on over 40 beautiful automobiles built between 1950 and 1969, including the 507 from BMW. Also: Classic at the Syrena crash races in Poland. (Station info).

programme.title: Green wave
programme.desc: Electric cars are emotionless and boring? These electric cars want to prove the opposite: The VW ID. Buzz GTX throws all-wheel drive and 340 hp into the ring. But how athletic is he really? And this isn't an electric car at all, at least that's how it's supposed to sound and feel. The Hyundai Ioniq 5 N makes you think you are sitting in a high-performance gasoline engine. We reveal how exactly this works. (Station info).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.sub-title: Porsche Panamera production plant in Leipzig
programme.desc: In 2004, the Leipzig location received an accolade. It was decided to build the Carrera GT super sports car here, which cost 452,000 euros. But the biggest challenge comes with the idea of ​​producing a four-door sedan parallel to the Cayenne: the Porsche Panamera. However, before this sports sedan hits the road, it has to go through 71 logistically perfectly organized stations. (Station info).

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: The future of mobility will be diverse! Also for people who want to drive themselves. BMW presents mixed reality: driving virtual routes in a real car. This is already possible today with the BMW Driving Experience. The Mercedes Vision AVTR is still a long way from being ready for series production. The concept car is inspired by the film Avatar and is intended to literally merge with the driver. (Station info).

programme.title: 4x4 – Das Allrad Magazin
programme.sub-title: Luxury toys for the large sandpit
programme.desc: A Porsche 911 as an off-road machine? Delta 4x4 makes it possible! In the gravel pit, the converted sports car shows that it not only delivers impressive performance on the road. And we test the new Range Rover in Germany's largest off-road park. Here, children aged 11 and over can also drive themselves under the guidance of experienced instructors and learn how to navigate the terrain safely. (Station info).

programme.title: Tuning – it doesn’t get any lower than that!
programme.desc: Bigger is better! Carol Shelby thought so and installed drilled Ford blocks in his AC Cobras. He later added the powerful engines to his Shelby Mustangs until Ford officially added the tuning models to its range. Even today, the Shelby legend lives on in its vehicles. If you want something even bigger, you can choose the Dodge RAM 1500 Rebel by Geiger Cars. It balances 400 hp from a 5.7 liter HEMI unit on the rear axle and optionally also on all fours. And then there is drift king Ken Block. He shows us his latest toy: a Ford F-150 Raptor with chains instead of wheels for the well-groomed little one (channel info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: In this episode, top speed presenter and official ambassador of the 1000 Miglia Martin Utberg offers viewers a unique look behind the scenes of the world-famous classic car race 1000 Miglia. Viewers will get a glimpse of how the organization carries out its work with the deployment of thousands of employees during this famous race in Italy from Brescia to Rome and back. (Station info).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: 150 cars are sold every minute. Worldwide. In no other industry is marketing as important as in the automotive industry. Brands, models and advertising campaigns have been closely interlinked for decades. In the third part of the "History of Automotive Advertising", Car History shows the development of car advertising since the 90s with entertaining and unusual spots and also shows which web videos car companies use the Internet as an advertising platform. (Station info).
